ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution with approximately 82% low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels and 18% high-intensity (white/light grey) pixels across the visible ventral surface area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity pixel clusters are localized to the distal regions. The right lobe contains a diffuse, high-intensity patch in the upper-outer quadrant. The left lobe exhibits high-intensity stippling along the trailing edge and a concentrated cluster at the distal tip.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated internal vertex angle of approximately 64 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations (peaks and valleys) occur continuously along the entire trailing edge boundary, with increased pixel amplitude towards the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The outer margins of both lobes exhibit a strong convex curvature, sweeping laterally and upward to acute terminal points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Visible clusters of roughly circular, high-intensity pixel groups (diameters 3-12 pixels) concentrated on the outer-most lateral margins of both the left and right fluke lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A single high-intensity linear pixel disruption is visible diagonally on the lower medial quadrant of the left fluke lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Aggregated circular scarring clusters, likely from barnacle colonization, are present along the distal-lateral boundaries of both lobes.
